condition_types.EVENT: Fires at a specific moment — tight, precise
condition_types.STATE: Can be true for hours — use only as filter, never alone

_legend.rule: Every set must have at least 1 EVENT condition as anchor

buy_sets.name: TEST_DEBUG_STRATEGY
buy_sets.notes: Always triggers true. Used ONLY for debugging/testing the API pipeline.

buy_sets.name: BUY_STEADY_MOMENTUM_TREND
buy_sets.notes: Custom Streak strategy: 14-period SMA of median price > VWAP and EMA20, plus prev close > EMA20 and current close > VWAP. Very strong trend continuation filter.

_conditions_audit.median_price_above_vwap: STATE — 14-period median SMA is above VWAP
_conditions_audit.median_price_above_ema20: STATE — 14-period median SMA is above EMA20
_conditions_audit.prev_close_above_ema20: STATE — Previous candle closed above EMA20
_conditions_audit.price_above_vwap: STATE — Current candle closed above VWAP

buy_sets.name: BUY_STREAK_MOMENTUM_BREAKOUT
buy_sets.notes: Mixed timeframe strategy from Streak. Uses previous closed candle for indicator stability (VWAP, EMA20, RSI) and current live candle for Breakout trigger over the previous 10 candle high.

buy_sets.name: SHORT_STREAK_MOMENTUM_BREAKDOWN
buy_sets.notes: EXACT MIRROR of BUY_STREAK_MOMENTUM_BREAKOUT for short selling. Uses previous closed candle for indicator stability and current live candle for Breakdown trigger BELOW the previous 10 candle low. Use ONLY on gap-down stocks to avoid clashing with long strategy.

_conditions_audit.streak_close_0_below_period_min_10: EVENT — Close(0) < Period min(10, Low(-1)) [mirror of close_0_above_period_max_10]

sell_sets.name: SELL_EMA_MOMENTUM_LOSS
sell_sets.notes: Custom exit for LONG positions. Close(1) breaks below EMA21. Fast, reliable trailing stop.

_conditions_audit.close_1_below_ema21: EVENT — Close(1) fell below current EMA21

sell_sets.name: SHORT_STREAK_MOMENTUM_RECOVERY
sell_sets.notes: EXACT MIRROR of SELL_EMA_MOMENTUM_LOSS for short cover exit. Close(1) crossed ABOVE EMA21 — momentum recovering upward, cover the short. Use ONLY for exiting short positions.

_conditions_audit.close_1_above_ema21: EVENT — Close(1) crossed above current EMA21 [mirror of close_1_below_ema21]

sell_sets.name: SHORT_SAVIOR_EXIT
sell_sets.notes: Dynamic bail-out for Short Engine when price recovers above EMA9. Extremely fast SL alternative.
